deviations: No model or paper-table experiment in L105; this is a course representation audit.
Retain separate raw user/item ID columns instead of remapping to one ID space; bijection checked.
Exclude state labels and 172-dimensional features from the studied projection.
Window interaction snapshots differ from cumulative graph states.
Arrival times are unobserved; use a=t only for the measured audit.
First/last timestamps in artifacts are audit metadata, not the studied snapshot features.
historical_data_identity: Pinned currently obtained release bytes, not independently established historical identity
